summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository, working by reading and editing files only. Tests, Black, and mypy were not run, per instructions, so formatting and type checks are unverified. Changes: (1) rich/segment.py: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 after ERASE_IN_LINE and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member to the ControlCode union. (2) rich/control.py: added the formatting entry producing ESC ] 0 ; title BEL, and Control.title(title) classmethod with docstring and Args entry, returning a Control with no style and one title control code. (3) rich/console.py: added Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor; it buffers Control.title only when is_terminal is true, returns True or False, and has a Google-style docstring with the required caveats. No Windows calls. (4) rich/_windows_renderer.py: one new elif branch calling term.set_title with the title from the second item of the code, without catching exceptions. (5) CHANGELOG.md: new Unreleased Added section with one bullet linking pull request 2200. (6) Tests: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Nothing was committed. Choices made: full GitHub URL in the changelog link; skip condition sys.platform == "win32" for the console test; title text is written without escaping, as specified.
